A record is invalid when the information cutoff (`known_as_of`) is later than the prediction timestamp (`predicted_at`). The cutoff must be at or before `predicted_at`, so equality is allowed. A later cutoff would use information learned after the prediction.

ANSWER_PATH: 07_EVALUATION/polymarket/PREDICTION_LEDGER_CONTRACT.md
ANSWER: `known_as_of > predicted_at` is invalid because it would use information learned after the prediction (`known_as_of` MUST be `<= predicted_at`).
